structured.answer: A deposit locks your money in a bank for a set time for interest (the example uses 1.8%). 15% tax comes off the interest, and breaking it early can cost the interest and even part of the money. But the example shows 70,000 ₪ in and 68,270 ₪ out, and there's no deposit insurance, so I'm not doing it.

Table says 'דמי יציאה ... לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'; no shekel amount, so I couldn't tell what breaking costs
